meta.title: TraceCode: see why your code failed, step by step
meta.description: Practice coding problems and, when a solution fails, replay its execution step by step: variables, loops and pointers, with progressive hints.

HomePage.title: Practice Python. When it fails, watch it run.
HomePage.description: Solve short problems in the browser. If a test fails, step through your code line by line and see the values change, so you know why.

signedOut.body: Progress is saved to your account once you're signed in. Until then, your runs on a problem page last only while that page is open.

recommendations.heading: What to practise next
recommendations.subheading: A suggestion based on your saved runs — your choice, not a rule.

insight.aiDisclaimer: Generated from your activity patterns and the structure of your code — the model never sees your source code.
insight.fallbackDisclaimer: Based only on your recorded runs and results.
insight.cooldown: You refreshed recently — try again in a few minutes.
insight.running: A refresh is already in progress.
insight.failed: Couldn’t refresh the AI insight right now — showing your latest.

reminders.heading: Reminders
reminders.description: Daily nudges built from your current recommendation. Each one is independent.
reminders.inAppHelp: A daily reminder in the bell at the top of the page.
reminders.emailHelp: One email a day with your recommended problem. Off unless you turn it on; every email has an unsubscribe link.
reminders.emailUnavailable: Email reminders aren’t set up on this site yet, so none will be sent for now.
reminders.failed: Couldn’t save that — please try again.

Notifications.heading: Notifications
Notifications.empty: No notifications yet. Your daily reminder will appear here.

UnsubscribePage.heading: Unsubscribe from reminder emails
UnsubscribePage.body: Confirm below to stop daily reminder emails. In-app notifications aren’t affected, and you can turn email back on from your progress page.
UnsubscribePage.done: Done — you won’t get reminder emails any more.
UnsubscribePage.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
UnsubscribePage.invalid: This unsubscribe link isn’t valid. You can manage reminder emails from your progress page.
